alerts.title: Trusted network drift detected
alerts.explanation: A known SSID was observed from a BSSID that is not present in the trusted baseline and on an unexpected channel.

evidence.description: TrustedNet is known, but BSSID de:ad:be:ef:00:01 is not in the trusted baseline.
TrustedNet was observed on channel 11 instead of the expected channel set.

limitations: Android companion mode provides environmental WiFi scan evidence, not monitor-mode packet capture.
alerts.recommendedAction: Verify the BSSID against the trusted router inventory before connecting.
